points.K19: 第4组：致命易传，无药无苗
points.K20: 病原资料单是常用参考
points.K21: 保存、检测、培养：风险递增
points.K24: 先问风险组和感染途径
points.K32: 实验室层面的评估清单
points.K34: 这些样本按最高风险对待

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验室门口，身边漂浮着各种微生物卡通图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a lab doorway with cartoon icons of microbes floating around it and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课，我们来认识生物因子。

shots.scene: 微生物图标排成一排，旁边是放大镜和评估表
shots.prompt_en: A row of cartoon microbe icons next to a magnifying glass and a blank risk assessment form. No people.
shots.narration: 它们有哪些种类，风险怎么评估。

shots.scene: 阿杰抱着一箱从野外带回的土壤样品袋走进实验室
shots.prompt_en: The young male student carries a box of sealed soil sample bags into the lab.
shots.narration: 阿杰带回一箱土样，准备直接开箱。

shots.scene: 小研举手示意他停下
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student raises a hand to signal the young male student to stop.
shots.narration: 小研拦住他：土里有什么，你知道吗？

shots.scene: 阿杰挠头，箱子上方浮现问号和一座冰山
shots.prompt_en: The young male student scratches his head; a question mark and a small iceberg icon float above the box.
shots.narration: 不知道的，往往才是最大的风险。

shots.section_title: 生物安全与生物安保：区别在意图
shots.scene: 两格对比：一边意外打翻试管，一边被锁住的样品柜
shots.prompt_en: Two panels: on the left a tube tipped over by accident; on the right a locked sample cabinet with a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 生物风险管理分两块：
overlay: 生物安全与生物安保：区别在意图

shots.section_title: 生物安全与生物安保：区别在意图
shots.scene: 左边意外打翻试管的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a tube tipped over by accident with a small splash. No people.
shots.narration: 生物安全，防的是意外释放；

shots.section_title: 生物安全与生物安保：区别在意图
shots.scene: 右边被锁住的样品柜和盾牌
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a locked sample cabinet behind a shield, with a door access reader. No people.
shots.narration: 生物安保，防的是有人故意滥用。

shots.scene: 三个相连的圆圈循环转动
shots.prompt_en: Three connected circles rotate in a loop with arrows between them. No people.
shots.narration: 管理的主线是AMP三步循环：

shots.scene: 循环箭头螺旋向上
shots.prompt_en: The looping arrows spiral upward like a staircase. No people.
shots.narration: 评估、减缓、绩效，一轮轮改进。

shots.section_title: 生物因子也是要保护的资产
shots.scene: 样品柜里的菌种盒上罩着一把锁
shots.prompt_en: A culture box inside a storage freezer with a padlock icon over it. No people.
shots.narration: 从安保角度看，菌种样本是资产，
overlay: 生物因子也是要保护的资产

shots.section_title: 生物因子也是要保护的资产
shots.scene: 小研在空白登记本上记录领用
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student records a sample withdrawal in a blank logbook beside the freezer.
shots.narration: 要像贵重物品一样管理。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着几张空白词卡
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up several blank word cards.
shots.narration: 先认几个常用词。

shots.scene: 一个人形标为第一个病例，旁边医院图标
shots.prompt_en: A person icon highlighted as the first case in a chain, next to a hospital icon. No people.
shots.narration: 指示病例，医院内感染，

shots.scene: 皮肤图标和针刺图标，地图上的分布点
shots.prompt_en: A skin icon, a needle-prick icon and a map with scattered dots. No people.
shots.narration: 经皮肤、经皮刺伤，流行病学。

shots.scene: 细菌、病毒、真菌和小瓶毒素图标围成一圈
shots.prompt_en: Icons of bacteria, a virus, a fungus and a small toxin vial arranged in a circle. No people.
shots.narration: 生物因子：细菌、病毒、真菌，

shots.scene: 其他微生物图标加入圆圈
shots.prompt_en: More small microbe icons join the circle. No people.
shots.narration: 其他微生物，以及它们的毒素。

shots.scene: 从打喷嚏到卧床再到红色警示的三级图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a person sneezing, a person in bed, and a red warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 轻则过敏，重则患病甚至死亡。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着一个有裂纹的健康心形图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a heart-shaped health icon with a crack.
shots.narration: 关键一点：它们会损害人的健康。

shots.scene: 大脑图标旁一个折叠错误的蛋白质小团
shots.prompt_en: A brain icon beside a small misfolded protein cluster icon. No people.
shots.narration: 朊病毒比较少见，

shots.scene: 人和牛的图标，大脑图标变灰
shots.prompt_en: A person icon and a cow icon, each with a greyed-out brain icon. No people.
shots.narration: 引起人和动物的慢性神经退行病。

shots.scene: 一个没有外壁的软细菌图标
shots.prompt_en: A small soft bacterium icon without a cell wall outline. No people.
shots.narration: 支原体，是没有细胞壁的细菌，

shots.scene: 一种带墙符号的药片被打叉，旁边肺部图标
shots.prompt_en: A pill icon marked with a wall symbol crossed out, next to a lungs icon. No people.
shots.narration: 部分抗生素对它无效，常犯呼吸道。

shots.scene: 病毒卡通图标，旁边血滴和红色警示
shots.prompt_en: A cartoon virus icon next to a blood drop and a red warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 病毒性出血热，由几个科的RNA病毒引起，

shots.scene: 药品图标上一个问号
shots.prompt_en: A medicine icon with a large question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 可能致命，很多还没有特效药。

shots.scene: 土壤和水滴图标里藏着细菌
shots.prompt_en: Soil and water drop icons with small bacteria hidden inside. No people.
shots.narration: 细菌里，不少来自土壤和水，

shots.scene: 细菌图标里出现一个硬壳小芽孢
shots.prompt_en: A bacterium icon with a tiny hard-shelled spore inside it. No people.
shots.narration: 有的能形成芽孢，非常耐受。

shots.scene: 小研在生物安全柜里轻柔操作，试管盖好
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student works gently inside a biological safety cabinet, tubes capped.
shots.narration: 这类细菌，要特别防气溶胶。

shots.scene: 圆圆的酵母图标外面有一圈透明外衣
shots.prompt_en: A round yeast cell icon with a thick transparent capsule around it. No people.
shots.narration: 酵母里，有带荚膜的致病种类，

shots.scene: 免疫盾牌有裂纹的人形图标
shots.prompt_en: A person icon with a cracked immune shield. No people.
shots.narration: 对免疫力低的人尤其危险。

shots.scene: 霉菌图标飘出小孢子
shots.prompt_en: A mold icon releasing tiny spores into the air. No people.
shots.narration: 霉菌等真菌，靠孢子随空气扩散，

shots.scene: 鸟粪和土壤图标，旁边一个小毒素瓶
shots.prompt_en: Icons of bird droppings, soil, and a small toxin vial. No people.
shots.narration: 有的来自鸟粪土壤，有的产毒素。

shots.scene: 免疫盾牌有裂纹的人形图标旁出现真菌
shots.prompt_en: A person icon with a cracked immune shield, fungus icons nearby. No people.
shots.narration: 免疫低下时，常见真菌也会致病。

shots.scene: 双螺旋和单链核酸图标，旁边警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A DNA double helix icon and a single-strand RNA icon next to a yellow warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 有些病毒的核酸，本身就有感染性。

shots.scene: 小研戴手套在安全柜里操作核酸样品
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in gloves handles small nucleic acid tubes inside a biological safety cabinet.
shots.narration: 操作核酸，同样不能大意。

shots.section_title: 改造过的生物因子也要防范
shots.scene: 一个病原图标外面套着一个带齿轮的标签，被红色警示框住
shots.prompt_en: A microbe icon wearing a gear-shaped tag, framed by a red warning border. No people.
shots.narration: 经过改造的生物因子，也要防范。
overlay: 改造过的生物因子也要防范

shots.section_title: 改造过的生物因子也要防范
shots.scene: 病原图标旁一圈问号和红色警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A ring of question marks and red warning triangles around a modified microbe icon. No people.
shots.narration: 特性被改变，就可能成为生物威胁。

shots.scene: 血滴里的寄生虫、水里的螺、蜱和蚤的图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a parasite in a blood drop, a snail in water, a tick and a flea. No people.
shots.narration: 还有血液寄生虫、水里的螺，

shots.scene: 小瓶毒素图标，旁边写着不是活体但有害
shots.prompt_en: A small toxin vial icon with a crossed-out heartbeat symbol and a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 蜱蚤能带病，毒素虽不是活体也有害。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁四个由浅到深的格子
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot beside four boxes in a row, shaded from light to dark. No people.
shots.narration: 这么多因子，怎么分类？按风险组。

shots.scene: 一本空白的国际生物安全手册和几本参考书
shots.prompt_en: A blank international laboratory biosafety manual and a few reference books on a shelf. No people.
shots.narration: 分组依据国际生物安全手册等参考书。

shots.section_title: 第1组：健康成人一般不致病
shots.scene: 最浅的格子，旁边一个健康笑脸人和酸奶图标
shots.prompt_en: The lightest box, next to a smiling healthy person icon and a yogurt cup icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第1组，健康成人一般不致病，
overlay: 第1组：健康成人一般不致病

shots.section_title: 第1组：健康成人一般不致病
shots.scene: 酸奶杯图标旁一个绿色对勾
shots.prompt_en: A yogurt cup icon with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 比如用作益生菌的乳酸菌。

shots.scene: 第二格，旁边轻度生病的人和药丸、疫苗
shots.prompt_en: The second box, next to a mildly ill person icon, a pill and a vaccine vial. No people.
shots.narration: 第2组，能致病，但可防可治。

shots.scene: 第三格，旁边卧床病人，药品疫苗打勾
shots.prompt_en: The third box, next to a bedridden person icon, with medicine and vaccine icons checked. No people.
shots.narration: 第3组，病重甚至致死，但有治疗，可能有疫苗。

shots.section_title: 第4组：致命易传，无药无苗
shots.scene: 最深的格子，旁边红色骷髅警示和长传播箭头
shots.prompt_en: The darkest box, next to a red skull warning and long spreading arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 第4组，致命，易在人与人之间传播，
overlay: 第4组：致命易传，无药无苗

shots.section_title: 第4组：致命易传，无药无苗
shots.scene: 药品和疫苗图标都被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Medicine and vaccine vial icons both crossed out with red X marks. No people.
shots.narration: 没有治疗方法，也没有疫苗。

shots.section_title: 病原资料单是常用参考
shots.scene: 一张空白病原资料单，列着几行图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank pathogen information sheet with rows of small icons. No people.
shots.narration: 常用参考是病原安全数据单，
overlay: 病原资料单是常用参考

shots.section_title: 病原资料单是常用参考
shots.scene: 资料单旁一个枫叶形的机构徽章图标
shots.prompt_en: The blank information sheet beside a plain maple-leaf badge icon. No people.
shots.narration: 由加拿大公共卫生署编写。

shots.section_title: 病原资料单是常用参考
shots.scene: 资料单上风险组、途径、处置三栏打勾
shots.prompt_en: The sheet shows three columns with icons for risk group, route and treatment, each checked. No people.
shots.narration: 风险组、感染后怎么处置都能查到。

shots.section_title: 保存、检测、培养：风险递增
shots.scene: 冰冻样品盒安静地放在冰箱里
shots.prompt_en: A frozen sample box sitting quietly inside a freezer. No people.
shots.narration: 同一种病原，操作越多风险越高。
overlay: 保存、检测、培养：风险递增

shots.section_title: 保存、检测、培养：风险递增
shots.scene: 保存、检测、培养三格，箭头由绿到红
shots.prompt_en: Three panels: storage, diagnosis, culture, with an arrow turning from green to red. No people.
shots.narration: 冻存最低，检测升高，大量培养最高。

shots.section_title: 保存、检测、培养：风险递增
shots.scene: 培养瓶旁一个齿轮图标和更大的红色警示
shots.prompt_en: A culture flask icon with a gear icon and an even larger red warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 改造病毒、用上新技术，风险更高。

shots.scene: 天平：一边骰子代表可能性，一边警示代表后果
shots.prompt_en: A balance scale: a dice icon on one side, a warning icon on the other. No people.
shots.narration: 风险，由可能性和后果决定。

shots.scene: 两个问号气泡：有多大概率、会怎样
shots.prompt_en: Two speech bubbles with question marks, one over a dice, one over a warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 概率有多大，万一发生会怎样。

shots.scene: 一张五乘五的彩色方格表
shots.prompt_en: A five-by-five coloured grid, green at one corner, red at the opposite corner. No people.
shots.narration: 风险矩阵，两个维度各分五级。

shots.scene: 左下角格子绿色，右上角格子红色
shots.prompt_en: The bottom-left cell of the grid is green, the top-right cell is red. No people.
shots.narration: 都低是低风险，都高是高风险。

shots.section_title: 先问风险组和感染途径
shots.scene: 小研拿空白评估表，第一问指向风险组格子
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds a blank form; an arrow points from it to the risk group boxes.
shots.narration: 评估先问：它属于哪个风险组？
overlay: 先问风险组和感染途径

shots.section_title: 先问风险组和感染途径
shots.scene: 人形图上吸入、接触、刺伤、食入四个图标
shots.prompt_en: A person outline with four icons: inhalation, contact, needle-prick, ingestion. No people.
shots.narration: 再问怎么进身体：吸入、接触、刺、吃。

shots.scene: 两条路径：直接人传人，和经蚊子媒介
shots.prompt_en: Two paths from one person to another: one direct, one through a mosquito icon. No people.
shots.narration: 看传播方式：有没有媒介参与。

shots.scene: 植物、鸟粪、土壤图标连到一个肺部图标
shots.prompt_en: Plant, bird-dropping and soil icons connected by arrows to a lungs icon. No people.
shots.narration: 宿主和来源可能很多样，

shots.scene: 孢子从环境飘进人体图标
shots.prompt_en: Spores drift from an environment icon into a person icon. No people.
shots.narration: 有的从环境里吸入就感染。

shots.scene: 一个病原图标连到哺乳动物、螺、鸟多个宿主
shots.prompt_en: One microbe icon linked to several host icons: a mammal, a snail, a bird. No people.
shots.narration: 有的病原能在多种宿主里生存。

shots.scene: 制定管理计划时把多宿主圈起来
shots.prompt_en: A planning board circles the multiple host icons together. No people.
shots.narration: 定管理方案时，要把这些都算上。

shots.scene: 培养皿上稀疏和密集两种菌落对比
shots.prompt_en: A petri dish icon with sparse colonies next to one with dense colonies. No people.
shots.narration: 感染剂量：多少量才会致病。

shots.scene: 一张地图，部分区域标色表示本地流行
shots.prompt_en: A map icon with some regions shaded to show endemic areas. No people.
shots.narration: 看它在本地流行，还是外来。

shots.scene: 本地人形带一点免疫盾，外来的没有
shots.prompt_en: A local person icon with a small immune shield; a visitor icon without one. No people.
shots.narration: 本地人可能已有一些免疫力。

shots.scene: 一张免疫检查单和一个带裂纹盾牌的人
shots.prompt_en: A blank immunology checklist next to a person icon with a cracked shield. No people.
shots.narration: 还要看工作人员的免疫状态。

shots.scene: 给免疫低下者加一层额外防护图标
shots.prompt_en: An extra protective layer icon added around a person with a cracked shield. No people.
shots.narration: 免疫低的人，要加额外的防护。

shots.scene: 一张清单，列着病原相关的几行图标
shots.prompt_en: A checklist listing rows of pathogen-related icons. No people.
shots.narration: 先理病原本身：

shots.scene: 风险组、途径、剂量、有无治疗四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons on the list: risk group box, route arrow, dose dish, medicine. No people.
shots.narration: 风险组、途径、剂量、能不能治。

shots.section_title: 实验室层面的评估清单
shots.scene: 另一张清单，列着实验室相关的几行图标
shots.prompt_en: Another checklist listing lab-related rows of icons. No people.
shots.narration: 再理实验室这边：
overlay: 实验室层面的评估清单

shots.section_title: 实验室层面的评估清单
shots.scene: 工艺、培养量、步骤、人数、培训、设施图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons for process, culture volume, steps, number of people, training, and facility. No people.
shots.narration: 工艺、用量、几步、几人、培训、设施。

shots.scene: 一座冰山，大部分藏在水面下
shots.prompt_en: An iceberg icon with a small tip above water and a large mass below. No people.
shots.narration: 风险像冰山，大半看不见。

shots.scene: 水面下的问号，提问也问不出
shots.prompt_en: Question marks hidden in the underwater part of the iceberg. No people.
shots.narration: 没有先例时，常规问题也问不到。

shots.section_title: 这些样本按最高风险对待
shots.scene: 欣欣举手提醒，身旁五类样本图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot raises a paw in caution beside five sample icons.
shots.narration: 有几类样本，一律按最高风险对待：
overlay: 这些样本按最高风险对待

shots.section_title: 这些样本按最高风险对待
shots.scene: 改造核酸、医院样本、土壤样本图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of modified nucleic acid, a hospital sample, and a soil sample. No people.
shots.narration: 改造核酸、医院样本、土壤样本，

shots.section_title: 这些样本按最高风险对待
shots.scene: 看似健康个体样本和野生动物样本图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a sample from a healthy-looking individual and a sample from a wild animal. No people.
shots.narration: 看着健康的、野生动物来的，都算。

shots.scene: 一座五层金字塔，从上到下五格
shots.prompt_en: A five-level pyramid icon with five stacked bands. No people.
shots.narration: 评估完就减缓，用五级控制：

shots.scene: 金字塔五层依次是消除到个人防护
shots.prompt_en: The pyramid's five bands, top to bottom: elimination, substitution, engineering, administrative, PPE icons. No people.
shots.narration: 消除、替代、工程、管理、个人防护。

shots.section_title: 绩效评估：审核措施是否落实
shots.scene: 王老师拿着空白审核表巡查
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator walks through the lab with a blank audit checklist.
shots.narration: 最后一步，审核措施落实没有。
overlay: 绩效评估：审核措施是否落实

shots.section_title: 绩效评估：审核措施是否落实
shots.scene: 对照规程本逐条打勾，一条红叉
shots.prompt_en: An audit checklist against a procedure book, rows checked, one red cross. No people.
shots.narration: 对照规程查，发现问题回头改。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁排着各类生物因子和四个风险组格子
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot beside rows of microbe icons and four risk group boxes shaded from light to dark.
shots.narration: 认清种类，按风险组一到四来分。

shots.scene: 评估清单、冰山和五级金字塔图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a checklist, an iceberg and a five-level pyramid. No people.
shots.narration: 评估多问几句，按最高风险对待。

shots.scene: 锁、审批印章和审核清单图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a padlock, an approval stamp and an audit checklist. No people.
shots.narration: 样本像资产一样管，减缓后要审核。

shots.scene: 欣欣和小研、阿杰一起挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye together with the female graduate student and the young male student.
shots.narration: 先懂因子，再管风险，下次见！
